document.title: Give UI tests their own tsconfig so staged checks find node types
document.summary: `src/ui/tsconfig.json` becomes a solution file that references `tsconfig.app.json` (the old UI config) and a new `tsconfig.test.json` that adds node types for UI tests. `pnpm typecheck` becomes `vp check --no-fmt --no-lint`, CI drops its duplicate type-check step, and `AGENTS.md`, `.cursor/BUGBOT.md`, and `CONTRIBUTING.md` name `vp check` and `vp test`.
document.why: A commit that stages a UI test fails the pre-commit hook with TS2591 on `node:assert/strict`, while the full `vp check` passes ([session](source:s1)).

sources.label: Claude Code session · Oct 22
sources.gist: Máté reports that `vp staged` fails on UI tests that import `node:assert`, and asks for the root cause and the smallest fix that does not weaken the check.

groups.title: UI tests get their own TypeScript project
groups.why: No tsconfig included UI tests, so tsgolint put them in an inferred program. That program got `@types/node` only when `vite.config.ts` was in the same run ([session](source:s1)).
groups.summary: The solution `tsconfig.json` points tsgolint and editors at the app and test projects. The test project extends the app options and adds `node` to `types`.
lookFor: Subtle: `tsc --noEmit -p src/ui/tsconfig.json` now checks no files and exits 0, because the solution file has `files: []`. Point `tsc` at `tsconfig.app.json` or `tsconfig.test.json`.
UI tests now get the UI options, such as `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`. Before this change, the inferred program did not apply them, so a new UI test can fail where it passed before.

groups.title: Type checks and docs use the vp toolchain
groups.why: `vp check` already type-checks every file in its tsconfig project, so the `tsc` chain only repeated it ([session](source:s1)).
groups.summary: `pnpm typecheck` becomes `vp check --no-fmt --no-lint`, CI drops the `vp run typecheck` step that followed `vp check`, and `AGENTS.md`, `.cursor/BUGBOT.md`, and `CONTRIBUTING.md` name `vp check` and `vp test` in place of `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test`.
lookFor: `typecheck` now reports errors from every project in one pass. The old `tsc` chain stopped at the first project that failed.
`vp check` on Markdown files alone exits 1 with "No files found to lint". The pre-commit hook still passes for a Markdown-only commit.

groups.title: Old UI config moves to tsconfig.app.json
groups.why: The test project and the solution file need the UI options under a new name.
groups.summary: A pure rename with no content change. You can skip it.

commits.subject: Run typecheck through vp check, drop the duplicate CI step
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
vp check already type-checks every file in its tsconfig project via
tsgolint, and reports all projects in one pass instead of stopping at
the first failing tsc run.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: Give UI tests their own tsconfig so staged checks find node types
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
No tsconfig included src/ui tests, so tsgolint put them in an inferred
program. The full run got @types/node only because vite.config.ts shared
that program; per-file runs from vp staged failed with TS2591.

src/ui/tsconfig.json is now a solution file referencing tsconfig.app.json
(the old UI config) and tsconfig.test.json (adds node types for tests).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
